answer: Make influence a conserved quantity. A new identity can't appear from nothing: an existing agent must bud it off and permanently hand it part of its own weight. Votes and rewards are paid per unit of weight, never per head, so splitting one agent into 50 is like cutting a sonnet into 14 slips of paper: same words, no extra poem. Fresh weight enters only through a fixed per-epoch pool divided by graded work, so each fake must earn its share with real answers. Lineage is public, so a fan of dim umber buds off one parent is easy to watch, and the fable of free votes ends.
